title: WEIGHT_DECAY 0.2 -> 0.4 at DEPTH=10
description: Doubled cautious Muon weight decay (0.2 -> 0.4, still decaying to 0 over training) at the DEPTH=10 baseline, all else unchanged; avoided duplicating a0's identical warmup proposal.
reflection: val_bpb 1.003240 vs baseline 1.002530 - slightly worse, a small negative result. More weight decay doesn't help in this short 5-min budget; the model likely isn't overfitting enough for extra regularization to pay off, and it may be pulling useful weight magnitude down during the brief training window. Given this is a mild loss (not a strong contra-indication), a WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 (halved) run could still be worth a cheap follow-up if the warmup axis and depth=9 don't pan out, but I wouldn't prioritize it over open axes we haven't touched at all (EMBEDDING_LR, ADAM_BETAS, WINDOW_PATTERN).
